name: Admin Document Create
description: Create a new admin document via Markdown paste mode or file upload mode, with title, a full-width Markdown editor whose Editar/Vista previa switch renders the preview in the editor's own box, and optional private notes opened from doc-client-note-open. Because no document exists yet, the modal labels its action Aplicar al borrador, keeps it in a fixed bar that enables only once a note changes, and explains before and after submission that creation is still required; the later create request persists every note without adding it to the PDF. The optional client/project association remains available through ClientAutocomplete plus ProjectSelect, including inverse project-to-client cascade and folder suggestions. The folder is chosen with DocumentFolderSelect (doc-folder-select): a search over name, path, client and project whose rows show location, owner and a non-active project state; automatic folders are never offered, the chosen one shows its full path, its ✕ retracts an inherited client, a ?folder= link to an automatic or archived folder proposes the nearest manual ancestor with a notice, and a failed folder read says so and offers Reintentar.
knownGaps: Cover toggles and template-style selection are carried by the same payload but are not asserted independently in this flow.
